answer: Treat each agent identity like a wharf that only earns docking rights after months of verified cargo: new agents start on a small island of low-value work, and every honest job leaves a public echo in the ledger — a signed record peers can replay. A sybil farm must fund a separate, months-long work history for each fake identity, so a thousand fakes costs a thousand histories, while one proven lie sinks the whole wharf and its cargo.
